doc.title: Scott Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe,Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997

title: Big band experience with Illinois Jacquet and Mel Lewis
summary: He enjoys all kinds of playing and valued working in the Jacquet and Mel Lewis bands and Thad Jones's music.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Well you’ve certainly played in an awful lot of big band situations. Do you like big band — Illinois Jacquet and those kind of things?

Yeah. I enjoy every kind of playing. I don’t have any particular love of big bands as a lot of people do, nor do I despise it. But playing with a great band, I mean you mentioned Illinois Jacquet and at the time I was in the band it was a really great band and a wonderful learning experience. And also Mel Lewis, playing with Mel Lewis’ band and touring with him, that was a great experience too. So yeah, I’m always thrilled and delighted to play with a great band playing great music. Thad Jones’ music is indescribably amazing, so that will never get old. I’ll play that stuff anytime.
